programme.title: Teasing Takagi-San S3, Ep 1
programme.desc: In the Season 3 premiere, Nishikata is determined to finally outsmart Takagi during a series of playful encounters involving grip-strength training, summer tans, and the first days of the new semester. However, Takagi always seems one step ahead, turning every challenge into another opportunity to tease him. Beneath their lighthearted rivalry, both begin to show subtle signs that their relationship is becoming more meaningful, blending comedy, romance, and everyday school life.

programme.title: Teasing Takagi-San S3, Ep 1
programme.desc: Pada episode pembuka musim ketiga, Nishikata kembali berusaha mengalahkan Takagi dalam berbagai tantangan sederhana, mulai dari latihan kekuatan genggaman tangan, membandingkan kulit yang terbakar matahari, hingga momen-momen di awal semester baru. Namun, kecerdikan Takagi selalu membuat Nishikata menjadi sasaran godaan yang menghibur. Di balik persaingan yang penuh canda, keduanya perlahan menunjukkan kedekatan yang semakin berkembang, menghadirkan kisah romantis remaja yang hangat dan penuh humor.

programme.desc: After her mother’s death, Jhanak is forced to marry her cousin Arshi’s fiancé, Aniruddh, to escape her stalker, Tejas. Although Aniruddh and Arshi have been together for seven years, Jhanak enters their lives under distressing circumstances and begins working as a maid in the Bose household. While some family members treat her kindly, others constantly insult and belittle her.

programme.title: Sayali
programme.desc: Udne Ki Aasha tells the story of Sachin and Sailee, a middle-class couple, as they navigate the complexities of their relationship. The story centers on Sailee’s struggles as she faces resistance from her husband and her efforts to inspire change not only for their own growth but also for the well-being of their entire family.

programme.title: Sayali
programme.desc: Udne Ki Aasha mengisahkan kehidupan kelas menengah Sachin dan Sailee saat mereka menghadapi kompleksitas hubungan mereka. Cerita ini berpusat pada perjuangan Sailee saat ia menghadapi hambatan berupa suami yang menolak dan upayanya untuk menginspirasi perubahan, bukan hanya untuk pertumbuhan mereka sendiri, tetapi juga untuk kesejahteraan seluruh keluarga mereka.

programme.title: Jaane Anjaane
programme.desc: A smart journalist Reet and hot-headed Raghav enter an arranged marriage through the 'Aata Sata' custom to secure their siblings' happiness. Their relationship of convenience faces unexpected turns.

programme.title: Jaane Anjaane
programme.desc: Reet, seorang jurnalis cerdas, dan Raghav yang temperamental, menikah melalui perjodohan berdasarkan adat ‘Aata Sata’ demi menjamin kebahagiaan saudara-saudara mereka. Hubungan mereka yang didasari kepentingan ini menghadapi lika-liku yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Teri Meri Doriyaann
programme.desc: The fate of the three Brar cousins Angad, Garry and Veer are linked with the three Monga sisters Sahiba, Seerat and Keerat. Sahiba is the hardworking and independent second daughter of the Monga family. She is an artist and earns money for her family by selling her art. Seerat, the eldest Monga sister, is pampered by her mother, Santosh, for her beauty. Santosh dreams of getting Seerat married to a rich man. As fate would have it, Angad falls in love with Seerat. However, Seerat is manipulated by Garry and his fake love. On Seerat and Angad's wedding day, Seerat runs away with Garry.

programme.title: Teri Meri Doriyaann
programme.desc: Nasib tiga sepupu Brar Angad, Garry dan Veer dikaitkan dengan tiga adik Monga Sahiba, Seerat dan keerat. Sahiba adalah anak perempuan kedua keluarga Monga yang rajin dan bebas. Dia seorang artis dan mendapat wang untuk keluarganya dengan menjual seni beliau. Seerat, kakak Monga yang tertua, dimanjakan oleh ibunya, Santosh, kerana kecantikannya. Santosh bermimpi untuk berkahwin dengan Seerat dengan seorang lelaki kaya. Seperti takdirnya, Angad jatuh cinta dengan Seerat. Walau bagaimanapun, Seerat dimanipulasi oleh Garry dan cinta palsu beliau. Pada hari perkahwinan Seerat dan Angad, Seerat melarikan diri dengan Garry.

programme.title: Pengorbanan

programme.title: Pengorbanan

programme.title: Arwah Sinden
programme.desc: Four architect friends Sergi (Rendy Septino), Dea (Ismi Melinda), Nike (Ade Kurnia Trisia), and Fanya (Tyara Vanesha) are tasked with renovating a house. While conducting a renovation survey, they experience ghostly attacks sent directly by Kliman (Yama Carlos), the foreman who built the house. Kliman (Yama Carlos) has a secret buried within the house, causing him to fear anyone attempting to rebuild it. The mystery begins to unravel with the arrival of the four architect friends.

programme.title: Arwah Sinden

Pada saat kegiatan survey renovasi dilakukan mereka mengalami serangan-serangan hantu yang dikirimkan langsung oleh Kliman (Yama Carlos), mandor yang membangun rumah tersebut. programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Seorang ahli bela diri licik mengincar para pendekar pedang muda berbakat. Namun, salah satu korban terdahulunya memutuskan bahwa sudah saatnya menghentikan semua itu.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian adalah seorang selir Kaisar Tang yang berusia 14 tahun nan cantik dan berbakat. Ia menjadi biarawati usai sang kaisar meninggal, tapi ia memiliki dua putra dengan Kaisar Tang Gao Zong.

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: This martial arts spectacular stars 20-year-old Derek Yee in a great performance as ace swordsman Third Master, who fights evil and saves damsels in distress.

programme.title: Death Duel

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Legendary actress Lin Feng Jiao stars in this romantic comedy as an unlikely romance occurs between an entrepreneur's son and a kindergarten's principal's niece.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Film komedi romantis yang dibintangi artis legendaris Lin Feng Jiao ini menceritakan kisah cinta yang tak biasa antara putra seorang pengusaha dan keponakan perempuan dari seorang kepala sekolah taman kanak-kanak.

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: A young woman tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sister's death, but is shocked to discover that her fiancé is one of them.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: Set in the Han Dynasty, a gang of loyalists led by Yang Chi-ching and Lin Dai, strive to drive a wedge between the governor and his son, eventually turning them against each other.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: Berlatar di masa Dinasti Han, sekelompok orang yang dipimpin oleh Yang Chi-ching dan Lin Dai, berupaya untuk memisahkan sang gubernur dengan putranya dan akhirnya menyebabkan mereka saling memusuhi.

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Millionaire Chu Te-Sa (Chiang) invests his considerable wealth into the rebel movement who are intent on usurping the ruling Mongol powers. His goals are impeded by a lack of support though and the supposed allies he has made in the town are merely eager to get their hands on his money. During an attack where these craven 'comrades' flee, Chu befriends three con-artists who relish the chance to show off their fighting skills. The trio subsequently agree to help Chu in his quest to end Mongol rule and hatch a plan to destroy a major munitions dump.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: Ling Yun plays the replacement hired for a popular band whose egotistic drummer quit to join a rival group.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: Ling Yun berperan sebagai pemain pengganti yang disewa oleh sebuah band populer setelah pemain drum mereka yang egois mengundurkan diri untuk bergabung dengan band saingan mereka.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: A dutiful cop, guilt-ridden over saving the life of a gang leader, becomes obsessed with bringing down the crime syndicate of the man he saved.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Seorang polisi yang berdedikasi dihantui rasa bersalah karena telah menyelamatkan nyawa seorang pemimpin geng. Ia kemudian terobsesi untuk menghancurkan sindikat kejahatan yang dipimpin oleh pria yang pernah diselamatkannya.

programme.title: Challenge Of The Gamesters
programme.desc: Wong Jing created the gambling film genre almost singlehandedly, and in one of his earliest blockbusters, Shih Hsien leads a stellar cast in a tale of spies, tycoons and beautiful babes.

programme.title: Challenge Of The Gamesters
programme.desc: Wong Jing menciptakan genre film perjudian hampir sendirian, dan dalam salah satu film laris awalnya, Shih Hsien memimpin pemeran bintang dalam kisah tentang mata-mata, taipan, dan gadis cantik.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: An imperial agent gets ridiculed for his various inventions, until his supportive wife encourages him to attend a conference, which's actually a trap to kill all the doctors serving the emperor, where his crazy inventions come in handy.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: Seorang agen kekaisaran diejek karena berbagai penemuannya, hingga istrinya yang suportif mendorongnya untuk menghadiri sebuah konferensi, yang sebenarnya adalah jebakan untuk membunuh semua dokter yang melayani kaisar, di mana penemuan-penemuan gilanya menjadi berguna.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: The story revolves around a dutiful yet indifferent fireman, who can march into disaster and risk his lives by saving others, yet would he have the equivalent courage to tackle his personal issues?

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang seorang pemadam kebakaran yang rela menerjang bahaya dan mempertaruhkan nyawanya demi menyelamatkan orang lain. Akan tetapi, apakah ia memiliki keberanian untuk menghadapi masalah pribadinya?

programme.title: Hail The Judge
programme.desc: A judge tries to save a female innocent who's wrongly being accused for murder.

programme.title: Hail The Judge
programme.desc: Seorang hakim berusaha menyelamatkan seorang wanita tak bersalah yang secara keliru dituduh melakukan pembunuhan.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: A Monkey King is reincarnated in the un human form as Joker, a highwayman oblivious to his original identity and the fact that 500 years earlier, he and his master, the Longevity Monk, were punished and made to stay human.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: Raja Kera bereinkarnasi dalam wujud bukan manusia sebagai Joker, seorang perampok jalanan yang tidak menyadari identitas aslinya dan fakta bahwa 500 tahun sebelumnya, dia dan tuannya, Biksu Panjang Umur, dihukum dan dipaksa untuk tetap menjadi manusia.

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: Hero Wah goes to study under Master Pride. When he returns to his parents, he learns that they have been murdered by a band of evil Westerners. After impregnating his wife Jade, he ventures to New York in search of his parents' killers.

programme.title: WAKAKIBO KIDS
programme.desc: AT THE BASE OF BANANA MOUNTAIN, RIGHT ON THE EDGE OF A FANTASY TROPICAL FOREST FILLED WITH VARIOUS CUTE AND ADORABLE ANIMALS, LIES THE VILLAGE WHERE OUR TWO FRIENDS LIVE: WAKA AND KIBO. WAKA, A CHILD WHO LOVES TO EAT AND LOOKS LIKE A SLOW CHILD, IS ACTUALLY VERY CAREFUL AND ALWAYS THINKING BEFORE HE ACTS. ON THE OTHER HAND, KIBO, WITH HIS THICK, CURRY HAIR, IS A CHEERFUL FIGURE, ALWAYS CURIOS, AND EASY TO MAKE FRIENDS WITH ANYONE. UNLIKE WAKA, KIBO OFTEN ACTS WITHOUT THINKING FIRST. THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP BETWEEN WAKA AND KIBO IN THEIR VILLAGE FULL OF COLOUR AND LIFE TAKES US ON ENTERTAINING AND FASCINATING ADVENTURES, WHERE THESE TWO CHARACTERS LEARN FROM THEIR DIFFERENCES AND COMPLEMENT EACH OTHER.

programme.title: WAKAKIBO KIDS

DI SISI LAIN, KIBO, DENGAN RAMBUT KERITING TEBALNYA, ADALAH SOSOK YANG CERIA, SELALU INGIN TAHU, DAN MUDAH BERTEMAN DENGAN SIAPA PUN. BERBEDA DENGAN WAKA, KIBO SERING KALI BERTINDAK TANPA BERPIKIR TERLEBIH DAHULU. KISAH PERSAHABATAN ANTARA WAKA DAN KIBO DI DESA MEREKA YANG PENUH WARNA DAN KEHIDUPAN MEMBAWA KITA PADA PETUALANGAN-PETUALANGAN YANG MENGHIBUR DAN MEMUKAU, DI MANA KEDUA KARAKTER INI BELAJAR DARI PERBEDAAN MEREKA DAN SALING MELENGKAPI SATU SAMA LAIN.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN

programme.title: BLUEY

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga sederhana dari kota besar memutuskan untuk meninggalkan gemerlap perkotaan dan kembali ke desa demi anak mereka yang takut pergi ke sekolah. Di desa, mereka berinteraksi dengan teman, tetangga, dan hewan-hewan sekitar, menyebabkan berbagai situasi canggung dan lucu yang tak berujung. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. Tiantian, sang anak yang berusia enam tahun, penuh dengan rasa ingin tahu dan cinta akan dunia, mulai berkembang menjadi pribadi yang sehat, mandiri, dan percaya diri di tengah keindahan pedesaan.

However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: Di dunia bawah laut, putri duyung bernama purple merindukan petualangan di daratan dan secara diam-diam mengambil risiko besar dengan mengubah dirinya menjadi manusia. Dengan bantuan pink star, peri penjaga bubblegem yang sedang tertidur, purple berubah wujud. Namun, penggunaan sihir yang berlebihan menyebabkan bubblegem, sumber kekuatan mereka, terpotong dan tersebar di daratan. untuk mengumpulkan kembali bubblegem yang tersebar, ratu laut white gold memerintahkan tujuh putri duyung dari kerajaan laut yang berbeda.

programme.title: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION
programme.desc: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION TELLS THE ADVENTURES OF FIVE SPECIAL TEENS—NAURA, RAHSYA, ADARA, GIBRAN, AND IRSHAD—WHICH ARE FOUND AND CARED FOR BY FATHIR. THESE FIVE CHILDREN HAVE UNIQUE AND DIFFERENT SUPERPOWERS. THEY USE THESE POWERS TO SOLVE VARIOUS CASES AND PROBLEMS THAT OCCUR AROUND THEM. IN ADDITION TO RESCUE MISSIONS, THEY ALSO HAVE TO FACE DAILY CONFLICTS AT SCHOOL, ESPECIALLY FROM THEIR ENEMY GANG, THE BEAST. THIS ANIMATION FOCUS ON THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP, COHESION, AND THE USE OF SUPERPOWERS FOR GOOD.

programme.title: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION
programme.desc: MAGIC 5 THE ANIMATION MENCERITAKAN PETUALANGAN LIMA REMAJA ISTIMEWA—NAURA, RAHSYA, ADARA, GIBRAN, DAN IRSHAD—YANG DITEMUKAN DAN DIASUH OLEH FATHIR.KELIMA ANAK INI MEMILIKI KEKUATAN SUPER YANG UNIK DAN BERBEDA. MEREKA MENGGUNAKAN KEKUATAN TERSEBUT UNTUK MEMECAHKAN BERBAGAI KASUS DAN MASALAH YANG TERJADI DI SEKITAR MEREKA. SELAIN MISI PENYELAMATAN, MEREKA JUGA HARUS MENGHADAPI KONFLIK SEHARI-HARI DI SEKOLAH, TERUTAMA DARI GENG MUSUH MEREKA, THE BEAST. ANIMASI INI BERFOKUS PADA KISAH PERSAHABATAN, KEKOMPAKAN, DAN PENGGUNAAN KEKUATAN SUPER UNTUK KEBAIKAN.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: FOLLOW THE EXCITING ADVENTURES OF PAK SOMAT'S FAMILY AS THEY STARTED A NEW LIFE IN CITEKO! FROM BUILDING BU INAH'S DREAM STORE, THE EXCITEMENT OF BEING NEIGHBORS WITH CEU KOKOM, TO PAK SOMAT'S STRUGGLE TO BECOME AN ONLINE MOTORCYCLE TAXI FOR THE SAKE OF HIS FAMILY. A WARM STORY FULL OF LAUGHTER AND A MORAL MESSAGE SUITABLE FOR ALL AGES.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: IKUTI PETUALANGAN SERU KELUARGA PAK SOMAT SAAT MEMULAI HIDUP BARU DI CITEKO! DARI MEMBANGUN WARUNG IMPIAN BU INAH, KEHEBOHAN BERTETANGGA DENGAN CEU KOKOM, HINGGA PERJUANGAN PAK SOMAT MENJADI OJEK ONLINE DEMI KELUARGA. KISAH HANGAT PENUH TAWA DAN PESAN MORAL YANG COCOK UNTUK SEMUA UMUR.

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (STRATEGI SHUKE & BEITA MENGHADAPI MAINAN JAHAT)
programme.desc: When Shuke and Beita discover a mysterious antique toy in an old warehouse in their town, they quickly realize that this toy is no ordinary toy it’s alive and plotting to take over the children’s playground in town.

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (STRATEGI SHUKE & BEITA MENGHADAPI MAINAN JAHAT)
programme.desc: Ketika Shuke dan Beita menemukan mainan-antik misterius di gudang tua kota mereka, mereka segera menyadari bahwa mainan tersebut tidak seperti mainan biasa — ia hidup dan punya rencana jahat untuk menguasai taman bermain anak-anak di kota itu.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 28 HORIZONS - RISING HOPE
programme.desc: Liko and Roy's adventure reaches a whole new level! Joined by their new friend Ult and Roy's Lucario, which can Mega Evolve, they reunite with the Rising Volt Tacklers. Together, the heroes set out to investigate the mystery behind a strange pink mist that is affecting Pokémon across different regions.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 28 HORIZONS - RISING HOPE
programme.desc: PETUALANGAN LIKO DAN ROY BERLANJUT KE LEVEL BARU! BERSAMA TEMAN BARU BERNAMA ULT DAN LUCARIO MILIK ROY YANG BISA MEGA EVOLUSI, MEREKA BERSATU KEMBALI DALAM RISING VOLT TACKLERS. KINI, PAHLAWAN KITA HARUS MENYELIDIKI MISTERI KABUT MERAH MUDA ANEH YANG MEMENGARUHI POKÉMON DI BERBAGAI WILAYAH

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: THE SOMAT FAMILY TELLS THAT WE MUST LIVE SIDE BY SIDE AND HELP EACH OTHER AS A COMMUNITY AND AS STUDENTS.

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS IS A POPULAR INDONESIAN CHILDREN'S ANIMATION WITH CHEERFUL AND UPbeat SONGS. THEY WERE CREATED AS A FORM OF INNOVATION IN THE CHILDREN'S MUSIC INDUSTRY IN INDONESIA. PLENTIS AND KENTUS ARE TWO BEST FRIENDS WHO ARE STILL IN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL. BOTH HAVE BIG DREAMS TO BECOME FAMOUS SINGERS. THEY LOVE SINGING, COMposing SONGS, AND PERFORMING AT VARIOUS EVENTS. THEIR ADVENTURES ARE FULL OF FUN, FRIENDSHIP, AND OF COURSE, LOTS OF SONGS THAT CAN MAKE CHILDREN SING AND SHOOT.

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS ADALAH SEBUAH ANIMASI ANAK-ANAK ASAL INDONESIA YANG POPULER DENGAN LAGU-LAGU CERIA DAN PENUH SEMANGAT. MEREKA DICIPTAKAN SEBAGAI BENTUK INOVASI DALAM INDUSTRI MUSIK ANAK-ANAK DI INDONESIA. PLENTIS DAN KENTUS ADALAH DUA SAHABAT KARIB YANG MASIH DUDUK DI BANGKU SEKOLAH DASAR. KEDUANYA MEMILIKI MIMPI BESAR UNTUK MENJADI PENYANYI TERKENAL. MEREKA SUKA BERNYANYI, MENCIPTAKAN LAGU, DAN TAMPIL DI BERBAGAI ACARA. PETUALANGAN MEREKA PENUH DENGAN KESERUAN, PERSAHABATAN, DAN TENTU SAJA, BANYAK SEKALI LAGU-LAGU YANG BISA MEMBUAT ANAK-ANAK IKUT BERNYANYI DAN BERGOYANG.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU AND ADUL IS A 3D ANIMATED FILM SERIAL ABOUT THE ADVENTURES OF CHILDREN IN THE MULTICULTURAL SUBURBS OF JAKARTA. THEIR INQUIRIES MAKE THEM WANTED TO EXPLORE, SOMETIMES CAUSING A FUCKING FUCK.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU DAN ADUL ADALAH SEBUAH SERIAL FILM ANIMASI 3D TENTANG PETUALANGAN ANAK-ANAK DI KAWASAN PINGGIRAN JAKARTA YANG MULTIKULTURAL. KARAKTER ANAK YANG SELALU INGIN TAHU MEMBUAT MEREKA INGIN SELALU BEREKSPLORASI HINGGA KADANG MENIMBULKAN KEHEBOHAN

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: Serial madun menceritakan perjalanan hidup madun (16 tahun) dalam memperjuangkan cita-citanya menjadi pesepakbola. Ayahnya, syafei (50 tahun) keturunan medan sangat menginginkan anaknya menjadi ustadz. Karena itu. Syafei selalu menghalangi upaya madun mencapai cita-citanya itu. baginya, pilihan madun hanya satu. Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. Ia tak tega mengekang madun yang mencintai bola. Namun untuk mewujudkan mimpinya. madun menghadapi banyak persaingan.

programme.title: Oddbods

They give parents the opportunity to teach and play with their children as they watch together.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: Animasi dan lagu 3d berbahasa indonesia, cocomelon menciptakan dunia yang berpusat pada pengalaman sehari-hari anak kecil. selain membantu anak-anak prasekolah mempelajari huruf, angka, suara binatang, warna, dan banyak lagi. video tersebut memberikan pelajaran kehidupan prososial. memberi orang tua kesempatan untuk mengajar dan bermain dengan anak-anak mereka saat mereka menonton bersama.

programme.title: THE FIXIES
programme.desc: THE FIXIES is a Russian animated series that follows the adventures of the Fixies, tiny creatures who live inside electronic devices. They secretly repair everyday technological problems while teaching viewers about science and technology in a fun and engaging way. The series is designed to help children learn about electronic devices and the importance of properly maintaining them.

programme.title: THE FIXIES
programme.desc: THE FIXIES ADALAH SERIAL ANIMASI RUSIA YANG MENGIKUTI PETUALANGAN PARA "FIXIES," MAKHLUK KECIL YANG HIDUP DI DALAM PERANGKAT ELEKTRONIK. SERIAL INI DIRANCANG UNTUK ANAK-ANAK UNTUK BELAJAR TENTANG PERANGKAT ELEKTRONIK DAN PENTINGNYA PERAWATANNYA.

programme.desc: The legendary Marsupilamis swap the wild Palombian jungle for an even wilder place: the city. There, twins Jade and Mica find their world turned upside down when their explorer parents entrust them with three mysterious Marsupilami eggs. programme.title: The Marsupilamis

programme.title: Gods Of Egypt

programme.title: Jason Bourne

programme.title: Legend Of Kitchen Soldier, Ep 5
programme.desc: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier follows Kang Seong-jae, a young man from a humble background who joins the army after losing his father. Although he excels during training, he is assigned to work in the military kitchen due to his experience helping at his father's food truck. One day, a mysterious virtual interface appears before him and begins assigning cooking-related missions. As he completes each challenge, his culinary skills improve dramatically, earning the respect of fellow soldiers and superiors alike. Alongside the humor and camaraderie of military life, Seong-jae gradually uncovers hidden secrets connected to his father's death. Blending military comedy, fantasy, and food-themed storytelling, the series delivers an uplifting tale of perseverance, friendship, and self-discovery.

programme.title: Legend Of Kitchen Soldier, Ep 5
programme.desc: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier mengisahkan Kang Seong-jae, seorang pemuda dari keluarga sederhana yang memutuskan masuk militer setelah kematian ayahnya. Meski menjadi lulusan terbaik selama pelatihan, ia justru ditempatkan di bagian dapur karena pengalamannya membantu usaha food truck milik sang ayah. Kehidupannya berubah ketika sebuah sistem misterius layaknya permainan video muncul dan memberinya berbagai misi memasak. Setiap tantangan yang berhasil diselesaikan membuat kemampuan memasaknya berkembang pesat hingga ia menjadi sosok yang dihormati oleh rekan-rekan dan atasannya. Di balik kisah penuh humor dan semangat kebersamaan di barak militer, Seong-jae juga perlahan menemukan petunjuk tentang rahasia yang mungkin berkaitan dengan kematian ayahnya. Serial ini memadukan komedi, fantasi, dunia kuliner, dan kisah pertumbuhan diri dalam sebuah petualangan yang menghibur dan hangat.

programme.title: Super Naani
programme.desc: The movie revolves around how an Indian woman, Bharti, who sacrifices her life for her children and husband, and yet they do not value her or her sacrifices, and they all maltreat her. Then tables turn when her grandson, Mann comes to her rescue. He gets her modeling assignments which makes her more successful than any of the family members, including her husband. Even after so much success she misses the love and affection of family members. Mann suggests her to teach everyone in the house a lesson so that they start to value her. The movie has a happy end where she reunites with her family and they learn to respect her and value the efforts she makes for keeping them happy. The moral of the movie is importance of your mother and what all she does for you. Respecting her and valuing her efforts.
